trend.note: Pruning does NOT create independence - it removes DUPLICATED WEIGHT. The effective-independent count is bounded by the member count, so it can fall when members are dropped while the family's information is unchanged. Measured across all five families: 19 members carrying 10.15 effective signals became 16 carrying 10.19.
trend.tie_break: VIFs within 1% are treated as tied and the member declared LATER is dropped; under perfect collinearity the choice is arbitrary by construction.

integrity.gate_rule: adj_close vs an independent vendor: at least 10 ANGEL MATCHes to the paisa and ZERO MISMATCH / MISSED_ACTION. UNCHECKED and VENDOR_ADJ are counted separately, so neither a non-verification nor a partly-explained residual can read as a clean match.
integrity.limitation: Angel reaches only ~800 days, so PRE-2023 BARS HAVE NO BROKER-GRADE VALIDATION - stated rather than implied. No vendor serves unadjusted history (both Angel and yfinance back-adjust), so the comparison is on adj_close and is a test of the whole corporate-action pipeline. A DEMERGER ratio is not rational and can only be approximated. Small DOWNWARD residuals from vendor dividend/demerger adjustment are reported as VENDOR_ADJ; their exact magnitudes are NOT reproduced and that is stated, not glossed.

ws_0_5_effective_sample.note: The largest eigenvalue share IS the market factor. A high share is exactly why WS-3 neutralizes the label - without it a model learns that one factor and reports it as stock selection.
